description: One job whole: what to do (steps), each item with its ref, words, picture addresses, poll options and the time it should go out, and its state. A photos job has one item per real place or thing: what it is, where, how many pictures wait for it and where Marsell already looked. A batch of directory listings has one item per place, best fit first, and the listing kit in its steps. A job whose items can end more ways than a link or a reason lists them (outcomes: each one's key, what it means, and whether it takes a link or says where it stopped). A job's steps say where it is done, as its needs does (the missions profile, the owner's mailbox, their files, or their own account on a site), and which steps stay the owner's (on a Google Ads account: adding the payment method and pressing Connect Google Ads); leave those to them. Read a job here before you take it. Once you have taken it with homework_take, do it in the owner's name as the steps say and report it with homework_done; a job you haven't taken isn't yours to do, except one with do_with, which is done with that tool and never taken.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

session.description: This wake's session, if you pass one on every call. A read ignores it.
